## Required Source Behavior

## Required Layout Changes

- Make the page Tabs root, tab list, triggers, content, and member rows shrinkable.
- Force the multi-row tab list to use its content height rather than the shared fixed horizontal height.
- Let labels and counts wrap inside tab cells.
- Group status and member actions in a wrapping full-width control area on narrow screens and an intrinsic-width area from the small breakpoint upward.
- Prefer page-scoped classes. Do not modify shared UI primitives.
